name: Departing
overview: The biblical concept of departing involves a movement from death to eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ, the Word who was with God and is God from the beginning. God's love is demonstrated by giving His only begotten Son so that believers do not perish but receive everlasting life, a promise established before the world began. This hope in eternal life is grounded in God's unchanging truth, while the community of believers is encouraged to confess faults and pray fervently for one another, reflecting the power of righteous intercession in the journey of faith.
